title: Classifying a Cubic with Only Odd Powers
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether g(x)=x^3-5x is even, odd, or neither.

steps.title: Evaluate at -x
steps.explanation: Odd powers flip sign when the input is negated.

steps.title: Factor Out the Minus
steps.explanation: The negated expression is exactly minus the original rule.
steps.why: Extracting -1 from every term reveals the original g(x).

steps.title: Conclude Oddness
steps.explanation: The odd-function identity holds for all real x, so g is odd.
steps.why: A polynomial with only odd-degree terms is automatically odd.
